decisionSourceAudit.D-01: Mid-sync settings change or source deletion wins over the in-flight sync: rejected with source_changed/unknown_source and latest settings survive. Proven by src-tauri/src/skill_host/store.rs::tests::phase08_01_actual_upsert_config_change_and_revert_reject_old_revision (all three edges) and the 08-27 native D-01 case.
decisionSourceAudit.D-02: No duplicate or queued source run: the duplicate sync rejects immediately with source_busy while the in-flight operation completes once. Proven by src-tauri/src/skill_host/store.rs::tests::phase08_01_duplicate_is_immediate_and_independent_source_progresses and the 08-27 native D-02 case.
decisionSourceAudit.D-03: Sync All skips the busy source and persists successful siblings with manual-only retry. Proven by src-tauri/src/skill_host/store.rs::tests::phase08_batch_transactions::busy_a_skips_while_b_persists_and_c_fails_then_manual_retry and the 08-27 native D-03 case.
decisionSourceAudit.D-04: A user-started operation survives screen changes with exactly one existing-surface terminal notice; classification and publication happen in src/lib/processingOperations.ts::runProcessingOperation (plan 08-25/08-26 ownership) before any view admission. Proven by the 08-27 native D-04 case and the runProcessingOperation/startSkillOperation unit suites.
decisionSourceAudit.D-05: Failures carry actionable reasons, partial success is retained and retry is manual only. Proven by the phase08_batch_transactions mixed-outcome case and the 08-27 native D-05 case.
decisionSourceAudit.PERF-02: A source removed while its sync is in flight is never resurrected by the late write-back; the tombstone is recorded. Proven by src-tauri/src/skill_host/store.rs::tests::phase08_01_deleted_source_never_returns_at_all_three_edges (before_admission/network/before_commit edges), src-tauri/src/skill_host/store.rs::tests::adding_source_clears_removed_source_tombstone, and the 08-27 native PERF-02 case (removal survives, removedSourceIds records the tombstone).
decisionSourceAudit.PERF-01: Main-thread-blocking commands are isolated on awaited spawn_blocking boundaries (356 ISOLATED, 9 UI-affinity rows) and the 08-27 native saturation run proves an unrelated same-runtime probe stays flat under four overlapping real operations on a two-worker runtime: probe p95 2ms, parse p95 7ms, max stall 9ms, missing 0, with the blockingAsync negative control violating the frozen probe bound (loaded p95 4789ms vs 27ms).
decisionSourceAudit.D-09: Native runner fixtures live only under per-run mkdtemp roots via MARU_NATIVE_E2E_HOME; the load-control change/revert seam refuses any source whose canonical path escapes the fixture root. No live workspace, credential or public remote is touched.
decisionSourceAudit.D-10: Default-feature binary and normal frontend carry no native-e2e affordances: scripts/check-native-e2e-isolation.mjs scans the produced bundle and the produced binary for the WebDriver plugin crate names, the MARU_NATIVE_RESPONSIVENESS_HOOK marker and both native-only command symbols; the feature-on artifacts were observably rejected (exit 1) and the normal artifacts pass (exit 0) on 2026-09-06.

integrationOverlay.role: reference overlay, never additional command rows

shipIsolation.featureOnRejection: exit 1 on the feature binary (all five binary markers) and on the native-e2e dist (all three bundle markers), recorded 2026-09-06
shipIsolation.normalArtifacts: exit 0 on pnpm build:frontend dist and on the default-feature src-tauri/target/debug/maru, recorded 2026-09-06
